risk_note: B2-02x (BR-FUND-19 细则「差异以分录为准修正」/ BR-FUND-16 加锁流程; 编排 D10-2032 / D10-2041 / D10-2084 / D10-2092 / D10-2097 / D10-2227): POST /admin/v1/recon-diffs/{recon_diff_id}/balance-recalc (fund.recon.balance_recalc, sms step-up) recalculates one member's account_balances cache from the member-sign sums of the ledger entries under the recon_diffs row lock, identity's users-row lock and the balance-row lock (FOR UPDATE, in that order); writes available / frozen (down as well as up) with version + 1 by compare-and-set; refuses a negative frozen sum and any sum or cached value outside ±(2^53 − 1) with 20001 and a refusal audit; negative_since and zero-crossing follow B2-02y; the clock is read once after both locks and the sums (money r1 S1, 4921ad19b); source ref recalc:<recon_diff_id>:<version>; a BALANCE_CORRECTED inbox notice in the same transaction when available changes. No voucher, no difference closed, no hold released. openapi.yaml drops the planned mark of this one operation (planned-operations.gen.ts and route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated). The shared-guard / audit-redaction findings of money r1 (free-text reason PII, step-up token kept on an unknown commit, long amounts masked as phone numbers) are outside this task and filed as FU-AUDIT-REASON-FREE-TEXT-PII, FU-STEPUP-COMMIT-UNKNOWN-RETAIN, FU-AUDIT-AMOUNT-AS-PHONE (D10-2227). Further rule tests on this implementation land with B2-02xb (D10-2198 / D10-2200).

reviews.note: money r2 incremental pass, no findings (couli-runs/B2-02x/review-money-r2-codex.json). r1 (review-money-r1-codex.json): S1 clock read before the lock wait, fixed in 4921ad19b with UNIT#23; S0 free-text reason PII, S1 step-up token released on an unknown commit, S2 long amounts masked as phone numbers — mechanisms in the shared AdminOperationGuard and admin/infra/audit-redaction.ts, transferred to FU-AUDIT-REASON-FREE-TEXT-PII / FU-STEPUP-COMMIT-UNKNOWN-RETAIN / FU-AUDIT-AMOUNT-AS-PHONE, scheduled before new task A (D10-2227); r2 confirms the transfer.

Spec-test r1–r4 independent Claude, then Codex after the 10-call limit (D10-2196): r5 S1 (old notices rewritten not caught) and r6 S1 (frozen decrease not checked on the stored row) were split into task B2-02xb per 规划/11 §2.5 (D10-2198 / D10-2200); r7 Codex pass with one S2 (audit sub-account swap) also covered by B2-02xb #9.
